name: Gemini 338Le
summary: Gemini 338Le is an industrial stereo camera with an IR bandpass filter for reliable robot depth sensing under mixed or strong ambient light. Gigabit Ethernet, Power over Ethernet and an IP67 enclosure support factory equipment, humanoids and AMRs. It synchronizes depth, infrared, RGB and motion data for multi-camera perception.

sources.quote: Orbbec also introduced the new Gemini 338Le and Gemini 338Lg stereo 3D cameras. Both offer enhanced resistance to ambient-light interference. The Gemini 338Le uses an industrial-grade Gigabit Ethernet interface, while the Gemini 338Lg provides a high-speed GMSL2/FAKRA connection, addressing differentiated integration requirements in demanding industrial and logistics environments.
